item.description: Connection across Tumen River is further sign of closer ties between the two countries since start of war in Ukraine Russia and North Korea have opened the first road bridge across their shared border , in the latest sign of the rapidly deepening ties between the two countries since the start of the war in Ukraine. The one-kilometre bridge spans the Tumen River between Khasan in Russia’s far east and Tumangang in North Korea, along a remote and sparsely populated stretch of the countries’ shared border just a few miles from the coast. item.title: What now for Germany's Merz after AfD win?
item.description: The far-right AfD's triumph in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt marks a defeat for German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and sends a warning to other European leaders battling the same mixture of slow growth and disillusion with mainstream politics. In an increasingly polarized political system, Merz, whose personal approval ratings have sunk ‌to record lows, was one of the main targets of voter ire over the cost of living, pensions and economic insecurity. France 24’s Philip Turle takes a look at what the AfD’s victory means for the German leader and for Europe. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Saxony-Anhalt poll: 'A huge blow for the CDU, but also a huge win for the AfD'
item.description: Carys Garland is pleased to welcome Markus Ziener, Visiting Senior Fellow at the German Marshall Fund. He interprets the AfD’s breakthrough in Saxony-Anhalt as a potentially historic turning point in post-war German politics. For Ziener, the significance lies not only in the scale of the far right’s electoral success, but also in the constituency behind it: many AfD voters, he argues, were previously politically disengaged rather than simply defecting from established parties. item.title: ¿El bombardeo contra una represa causó la riada mortal en Nepal?
item.description: Mientras Nepal continúa en emergencia, tras la fatal riada ocurrida el miércoles 26 de agosto, en redes sociales usuarios han asegurado que un bombardeo aéreo provocado por un presunto avión militar contra una represa fue la causa de la inundación que dejó miles de muertos, desaparecidos y millonarias pérdidas materiales. Pero estas publicaciones, que muestran el video del presunto bombardeo, son falsas y tienen como objetivo contradecir la versión oficial. item.title: Apparently CodePen 2.0 sends data to their servers as you type
item.description: They send all typed into editor input to codepen.dev almost immediately (you would see in 1-2 sec after you typed your secret that it appears in respective Network/Response tab) even before one saved it. I tested this with a unique marker: after typing it into index.html, CodePen ran a build with "save:false", and the marker then appeared verbatim in the HTML served from the generated "*.codepen.dev preview". Thus, if you ever entered some secrets in there by mistake consider them compromized even if you did not publish/save the pen Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49596976… Fuente: Hacker News - Portada.
